snippet.description:
Can Artificial Intelligence (AI) replace human jobs? Will AI transform India's education system and the future of employment? In an exclusive interaction with ETEducation, UPSC Chairman Dr. Ajay Kumar shares his insights on India's AI ambitions, education reforms, changing job opportunities and the skills required for the future.

In this video, we explore how India can become a global AI leader through regional language models, advanced AI skills, innovation and strong data infrastructure.

📌 UPSC Chairman Dr. Ajay Kumar's views on Artificial Intelligence  
📌 Can AI replace human jobs and entry-level employment?  
📌 Future of Jobs in India – Opportunities and Challenges  
📌 AI Adoption in Schools, Colleges and Higher Education  
📌 How India can become a Global AI Talent Hub  
📌 Regional Language Models and Small Language Models (SLMs)  
📌 India's Data Infrastructure and AI Development  
📌 Why Creativity and Critical Thinking Matter in Future Education  
📌 AI Applications in UPSC Recruitment and Administrative Processes  
📌 Will UPSC use AI to evaluate candidates?

Important UPSC Update: Dr. Ajay Kumar explained that UPSC already uses AI in administrative processes, including duplicate application detection and document scrutiny. However, UPSC currently has no plans to introduce AI for candidate evaluation. Human evaluation will continue.

He also highlights that AI may replace some jobs, create new opportunities and require professionals to reskill themselves.
This discussion is important for UPSC aspirants, students, teachers, educators and young professionals preparing for the changing world of work.

Watch the complete video to understand India's AI future and how students should prepare for upcoming challenges.

snippet.description:
How do you decide which questions to attempt and which ones to leave in UPSC CSAT?

In this video, Himanshi Ma'am, CSAT Faculty at LevelUp IAS, explains an important lesson from UPSC Prelims 2026: Attempting the right questions matters more than attempting every question.

Watch Full Video: https://youtu.be/bOJtn44qapU

Learn how to:
- Identify questions that are not worth spending too much time on.
- Avoid getting stuck on lengthy CSAT questions.
- Understand why a difficult-looking question may actually be easy.
- Strategically select around 45–50 questions out of 80.
- Manage time and maintain accuracy in the UPSC CSAT paper.

For UPSC Prelims 2027 aspirants, developing the right question-selection strategy can make a significant difference to your CSAT performance.

Watch the complete CSAT Strategy session to understand how to approach the paper effectively.

#UPSC2027 #UPSCPrelims2027 #CSAT2027 #UPSC CSAT #LevelUpIAS
